text:
Ivy: quick sync 1: partner asks to bundle HW appliance + reserved capacity + SI services as a single marketplace SKU. Need rules for escrow, key custody, and billing cadence.

Ben: high-level: if customer requires on-prem KMS/HSM or escrow -> route to direct private offer. Marketplace only for cloud-managed keys.

Harper: threshold suggestion: marketplace for deals <= $300k ARR equivalent; anything above -> private by default unless sales requests opt-in.

Diego: billing cadence friction: partners want monthly retainer draws against annual commit. Suggest "virtual annual SKU" that we reconcile monthly server-side; ops issues credits/charges at renewal.

Renee: partner margin at checkout is a blocker. Marketplace UI can't show split. Handle partner payout as off-invoice credits via Partner Portal and include a checkout note that partner payout is processed separately.

Ivy: fallback: if marketplace quota/policy prevents listing -> auto-create private PO and notify partner + seller with migration steps and 72h buffer.

Ben: telemetry: emit "convert_candidate" when usage >75% of committed band for 30 days OR sudden 2x month-over-month. Alert payload: `convert_candidate(customer, sku, band, pct_util, trend)`

Harper: legal requirement: SKU terms must state "Marketplace virtual SKUs may be migrated to private contract for onboarding, escrow, or compliance reasons; by purchasing you consent to migration and adjusted billing terms." I'll loop Legal.

Diego: ops ask: define overage policy -> overage billed at list rate unless customer upgrades band mid-term; escrow draws cover monthly retainer first. Add UI for mid-term upgrades.

Renee: marketing wants partner co-announce for any public listing; timeline: 3 weeks prep + partner signoff. Add to publish checklist.

PartnerBot: ticket filed: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-5304 (security review for HW-bundled SKUs).

Ivy: action items: Ben -> draft routing rules + PR (due Thu). Harper -> legal clause draft (due Fri). Diego -> reconciliation runbook + ops estimate (due Wed). Renee -> partner enablement checklist + announce timeline (due Tue). I'll open the PR and tag owners.

Ben: ack.

Harper: ack, looping Legal.

Diego: on it.
